pairs.summary: CREB1 and Nr1h3::Rxra motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 10 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; DLD-1 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; ...). Median lift 1.33x, typical spacing ~55 bp between sites. In 8 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: dimer motif, overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only (ChromBPNet not yet run for this pair).
